instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to about 30 degrees and lie chest-down on it.
2. Hold a barbell below you with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight down.
3. Pull the barbell toward your upper abdomen, driving your elbows back and close to your body.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
5. Lower the barbell with control until your arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest pressed into the bench to remove momentum.
2. Lead with your elbows, not your hands, to target the back.
3. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your neck neutral and gaze down.

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to about 30 degrees and lie chest-down on it.
2. Hold a barbell below you with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight down.
3. Pull the barbell toward your lower abdomen, keeping your elbows close to your body.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
5. Lower the barbell with control until your arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest pressed into the bench to remove momentum.
2. The underhand grip recruits the biceps more, so control the weight.
3. Drive your elbows down and back to load the lats.
4. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to about 30 degrees and lie chest-down on it.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, arms hanging straight down.
3. Pull the dumbbells toward the sides of your torso, driving your elbows back.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbells with control until your arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest pressed into the bench to remove momentum.
2. Lead with your elbows to target the back, not the arms.
3. The neutral grip balances lat and mid-back work.
4. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.
